ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: How will the minnow population change if there are less algae and floating plants?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, and the arrows indicate from the food source toward the organism that eats it. In the diagram, “Algae and floating plants (algae and floating plants)” has an arrow pointing directly to “ minnows (minnows/small fish),” indicating that minnows directly feed on algae and floating plants. Reasoning: If algae and floating plants decrease, the food supply for minnows decreases. A decrease in food usually causes the number of consumers to decline. Therefore, the minnow population will decrease.
